tools.name: list_bikes
tools.description: Bikes Unstocked covers, with their model-year groups. Optional query filters by make or model ("yamaha", "R7", "ZX-6R"). Use the slug with the other tools.

tools.name: get_build
tools.description: A ready-made build for one bike, model year and style (first-mods, carbon-street, track-day, track-only, budget-track). tools.name: get_parts
tools.description: Every part Unstocked lists for a bike, optionally for one model year or category. Each part has an id (for make_build_link), category, brand, tier, typical price, fitment note, flags (track-only, wants-tune) and whether it is listed for the model year. Also returns stock equipment and things to know

tools.name: make_build_link
tools.description: Turn a list of part ids into a link that opens the build on unstocked.bike. Use part ids from get_parts or get_build for the same bike. Checks every id fits the bike and that no two parts share a slot, and returns the total at typical prices.
